definitions.explanation: The official or formal name of an organization, product, place, or concept. More formal than {名前|なまえ} and typically refers to the established name of something rather than a person's name.

examples.japanese: {正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名称|めいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長|なが}すぎて⟦{覚|おぼ}え→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧にくい。
examples.english: The formal name of this law is too long to remember easily.

notes:
{名称|めいしょう} is the formal word for the official name or designation of an organization, place, product, or law. It is not used for personal names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}: official/formal name
- {名称|めいしょう}{変更|へんこう}: name change
- {名称|めいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧: to establish/set a name
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧{名称|めいしょう}: product name
- ⟦{略称|りゃくしょう}→略称：13562_ryakushou⟧: abbreviated name (related term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧: name (general, including personal names; everyday register)
- {名称|めいしょう}: official name/designation (formal; not for people)
- ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧: name (literary or formal; broader than ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧)
- ⟦{呼称|こしょう}→呼称：12126_koshou⟧: appellation, how something is called

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in official documents, legal texts, news reports, and business contexts.
